description.value: The Capilano Branch of the North Vancouver District Public Library is a community cornerstone located in the heart of Edgemont Village, offering a reading area, children's and teen sections, a quiet study room, and public computer workstations. Uniquely, the NVDPL system lists E-Cargo Bikes among its borrowable items, making this library system of direct interest to cycling-curious visitors. Free Wi-Fi and an accessible central location make it a practical stop for touring cyclists passing through North Vancouver's residential hillside neighbourhoods.

address.value: 3045 Highland Blvd, North Vancouver, BC V7R 2X4

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms the address (3045 Highland Blvd, North Vancouver, BC V7R 2X4), phone (604-987-4471), and branch identity. OSM internet_access=wlan is corroborated by the website's 'Computers & Wifi' listing under Learning & Technology, supporting Wi-Fi as true. No explicit mention of bike parking, washrooms, or water refill appears on the website or in OSM tags, so those remain null. Notably, the NVDPL borrowing menu lists 'E-Cargo Bikes' as a loanable item, which is a cycling-relevant detail worth flagging.
concerns: E-Cargo Bikes appear in the system-wide borrowing menu rather than on the Capilano Branch page specifically — it is unclear whether this service is available at this branch or only at other NVDPL locations.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A real, open, publicly accessible branch library in a central North Vancouver location with confirmed Wi-Fi; the NVDPL system's E-Cargo Bike lending program adds direct cycling relevance.
